title: Prove the 178-incidence P112 bound and rank-at-most-six strict-deficit corollary
body:
Eleven pieces containing six dimensions of the P112 code require at least **178 support incidences**, raising [PR #3991](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3991)'s uniform floor by 14. A discrete-convex capacity corollary excludes the entire explicitly bounded branch with **at most eleven pieces, binary support-rank bounds in {2,3,4,5,6}, strict excess Σ(w_i−2)<36, and code-intersection dimension at least six**.

The inherited capacities are 2,4,8,12,20, with nondecreasing increments 2,4,4,8. Concentrating the excess budget shows total capacity is at most 176; the unique sorted eleven-slot maximizer is the literal historical `(6,5)` caller **2²,5,6⁸**. Its quotient dimension is exactly five and code-intersection dimension exactly six. Zero padding extends the 178-incidence theorem to fewer pieces without assuming piece independence. Weight-seven pieces and more than eleven pieces remain outside the corollary.

The new step combines E8/coding theory with incidence geometry of three-planes sharing one two-plane. Two saturated six-root flats with a two-dimensional intersection must share at least two root lines. A bounded exact certificate checks 105 relevant Gram patterns and 6930 saturated-flat pairs. The exceptional orthogonal two-root kernels are covered by all 3780 quotient partitions, each with fiber histogram `{4:6,2:32,1:30}`. Grouping repeated coefficient columns and distinguishing full-root kernel count from live zero coordinates gives support floors178,187,186,185 in the four cases. Rational rank and intersection transfer give arbitrary characteristic-zero fields without an embedding into the reals.

The unchanged [PR #3154](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3154) filter accepts the named exact profile; the general capacity corollary does not require historical-filter completeness. Its preferred five-piece capacity 56 blocks the old below 53 quotient-basis route. Named predecessor shortening applications also fail their required capacity cutoffs; this is a bounded overlap screen, not a claim of first exclusion or complete historical reconciliation. No full C5 closure, frontier change, constructive algorithm or improvement to selected κ0.001672660197076918 is claimed.

Validation: the registered package passed its exact primary verifier, independent implementation using a fresh root shell/permutation determinants/Fraction elimination/pivot quotients, and controls for repeated columns, full versus live kernel roots, an actual code fixture, and optimized corrupted-receipt rejection. A tiny exact budget DP agrees with independent exhaustive multisets at every length zero through eleven, including the unique capacity maximizer and a weight-seven scope boundary. A separate agent independently reviewed scalar extension, candidate closure completeness and all four singleton cases. Human/formal mathematical acceptance remains open.

Credit: [PR #3991](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3991) at `e4eb3b7a1334b6fef88fc251c43d9940c8d38de8` supplies the incidence framework; [PR #3269](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3269) (Nick Petalas) supplies inherited capacities 12/20; [PR #3154](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3154) (DreamingOfClouds) supplies the historical caller/filter and generalized-weight premise; David Arias, joaqcoo and the retained E8/P112 lineage supply the root-code model. The frozen predecessor package and sources are unchanged. Chris R / Clear1nsight contributed with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.

Only `research/p112-saturated-projection-fibers/` is added. The proof separates the unconditional geometric incidence bound from inherited support capacities and the named caller premises. The next obligation is independent acceptance of the argument and those premises; another geometry expansion needs a different exact caller and fresh overlap check.

Final head `678886290dbacd454f49965a1808b8b3072b1c98`: exact committed bytes/source history, official export and read-only Git-free replay pass, with all 16 export files unchanged. [Hosted CI39228075861](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39228075861) passes at this head. Original31170e0 evidence is preserved separately.
